target.output: exclusive active claim per dedupe key

title: Fence concurrent portfolio claims
problem: The portfolio fallback contract requires an active claim to block duplicate execution, but each worker atomically creates a different unique claim filename. Live evidence shows multiple non-expired claims for the same job and dedupe_key, so append-only CREATE preserves evidence but does not elect one exclusive owner.
mission: Add an exclusive portfolio claim-ownership fence keyed by job/dedupe identity so exactly one concurrent worker gains substantive execution authority while losers persist collision evidence and immediately re-enter allocation. Preserve all historical append-only claims and returns.
acceptance: A portfolio job/dedupe key has at most one active non-expired claim across concurrent workers.
Losing concurrent claimant deterministically detects collision and re-enters allocation without duplicate execution.
Existing append-only claim evidence is preserved; fix adds exclusive claim ownership without overwriting prior claims.
Concurrency canary proves one winner and no duplicate execution authority.

observed_live_evidence.finding: Unique append-only claim filenames allow same-dedupe contenders to coexist; directory preflight is not an atomic ownership election.

unblock_value.reason: Makes portfolio fallback safe under the many-identical-chat launch pattern instead of creating duplicate substantive workers.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Workers can resolve claim races without asking the human which duplicate chat should continue.

regression_prevention.reason: A concurrency canary can prevent future allocator changes from reintroducing same-dedupe duplicate ownership.

information_gain.reason: Explicit winner/loser receipts make contention measurable rather than hidden in nearly simultaneous append-only claims.

risk.main: An over-broad fence could serialize distinct portfolio jobs or complementary read-only analysis.
risk.mitigation: Fence only substantive ownership for the same canonical job/dedupe identity; preserve parallel work across distinct dedupe keys and explicitly complementary roles.

falsification: Two simultaneous contenders for the same job/dedupe both gain substantive execution authority.
A losing contender cannot durably identify that it lost and re-enter allocation.
The fence overwrites or deletes existing append-only claim evidence.
Distinct dedupe keys are unnecessarily serialized by the fix.
dedup_note: Distinct from the existing recovery-generation race proposal: this defect is in normal portfolio fallback ownership, where unique per-worker claim filenames violate the contract's own active-claim dedupe law.

source_freshness.note: The public runtime epoch lagged live main during this discovery; evidence paths were fetched directly from main.
